clips.title: The story
paras: In Gnomeregan's heart, Tinkers' Court once gathered the city's leaders. Now Mekgineer Thermaplugg holds it.

Before disaster drove the gnomes from Gnomeregan, its leaders met in Tinkers' Court. High Tinker Gelbin Mekkatorque gathered there with advisors and master inventors, including Tinkmaster Overspark. They debated new technology, governed civic matters, and guided gnomish society. The chamber stood beyond the Engineering Labs and the Launch Bay, at the center of gnomish government and invention.
